@@ -1,3 +1,14 @@
+"""Worker exceptions.
+
+The retryable flag is consumer METADATA: the orchestrator's
+RetryHandler.is_retryable_error remains the authoritative decision
+point and may consult error codes beyond this flag.
+"""
+
+class ProcessingError(Exception):
+    def __init__(self, message, retryable=False):
+        super().__init__(message)
+        self.retryable = retryable
